name: take-two-gta-rdr2-sold-in-june-2026

angle.hook: Grand Theft Auto has sold in over 470 million units, by Take-Two's own filing
angle.why_now: evergreen, the newest filing before GTA VI (19 Nov) and before the 9 Nov results
angle.players_here: GTA V and Red Dead 2 are what most readers have played
angle.payoff: GTA V sold in more than twice what Red Dead Redemption 2 did

lines:

reel_check.SOURCE primary read in full: yes: Take-Two 10-Q for the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026 on sec.gov, read 8 Nov 2026 about 10:30Z; Rockstar Games section quoted in the story file
reel_check.SOURCE not already posted: yes: ledger find recorded; GTA VI road ep1 used the 10-K's GTA V 225M, this reel's 230M, 470M series and RDR2 85M are the newer 10-Q figures; space it from GTA VI posts
reel_check.SOURCE older than 24h: n/a: evergreen; dated by Take-Two's next 10-Q after the 9 Nov 2026 results
reel_check.TYPE NUMBERS: yes: figures, period (quarter ended 30 Jun 2026), source (Take-Two filing), comparison (GTA V more than twice RDR2)
reel_check.STORY one spoken paragraph: yes: 'سلسلة الألعاب تتجاوز 470 مليون نسخة. لعبة واحدة منها تتجاوز 230 مليونًا. ولعبة أخرى تتجاوز 85 مليونًا. تتجاوز مبيعات Grand Theft Auto V ضعف مبيعات Red Dead Redemption 2.' read aloud
reel_check.STORY subject named, no و opening: yes: the only line opens on تتجاوز; card labels may open on و

reel_check.POST source comment: yes: 10-Q link on X, none on Instagram
reel_check.SOUND: yes: our bed, stats flavour (graphics and stills, no footage sound)
reel_check.PICTURE footage first: n/a: filing figures; official box art and Steam screenshots, sources tried noted
